versions.changelog:
Initial release of gdd-cn: single-system Chinese GDD drafting assistant for domestic game development processes.

- Automates eight-section GDD creation: alignment, questioning, drafting, confirmation, and file writing in strict sequence
- Enforces “rules in docs, values in config tables”; no stray values in text
- Reads project context, dependencies, and prior decisions before starting; prompts user at all decision points
- Expert perspective self-check (lean/full/solo review modes), user must confirm/resolve all findings
- Supports collaborative, interruption-resilient workflow; progress tracked and restorable
- Only writes to files after explicit user confirmation
